full_page.content:
1933, September
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 139 Cont. Sept. 5 Marg. Harris - 21 - Enrolled May 3rd at time in hospital - then two months in London, Ont. sanitorium - mother promised a perpet- ual enrollment if she recovered. To-day comes O.K.
Bernard Geise - 26 - Auto-crash, unconscious since Saturday - away fr'm confession 7 yrs .... enrolled Aug. 5.
Caroline Ryiko - 9 - badly burned 2 week. Mrs. E. Bonner - 70 - Heart & Gall. R. Cotter - see April 24 ... O.K. 17 mo. baby improving ... Ignatio Bus - 37 - Rumatic ... confessio in 4 yrs ??? Blank Page
Page 140 Page 141
Sept. Mrs. Mary Sachse - 70 - Arthritis .. Viola Parent - 24 - wayward, Parents Heart sore.
Cath. Balfour - 43 - like paralized knees. Erma Ohs - T.B. in Kiefer ... 23. ...
Mrs. Olive Desmier - 4 - cancer of cervex Mrs. C. Harley - 67 - Goiter & nervous, discouraged.
10:10 P.M. just enrolled Fabile Brondin - 22 yrs. - reported "hope- less" in Ford Hospital - by phone.
Edith Nester - 22 - keeping company with a bitter non Cath. - Orange -man.
Mrs. Law - 34 - husband & 5 - fears cancer - or tumor. Edw'd Phillips & Co. Mrs. Jame Milone - 46 - of Wyan. Dr. Says Hopeless ! Ellen DiMaggio - 3 - unable to walk 2 months.
